title: [SOLVED] Engine issue: images not loading (but working in playtest)

posts.author: MushroomCake28
posts.body:
So I just changed my PC, and I'm running Windows 11 home. The PC is almost empty with not much running. The problem is that when I'm in MZ's engine no image can load. The events appear empty, in the data all images don't load, no icons, no faces, but maps do appear (I'm parallax mapping, but also using tiles for water. Both are working). When I playtest there is no issue, and there's also no issue to see images in the resource manager preview.
Does anyone know what is happening?
Thanks everyone!
EDIT: THIS WAS SOLVED. You have to run RPG Maker MZ in administrator mode to fix it.
EDIT 2: I got a PM from
@Andar
with further clarification:
just as a FYI:
Most likely the case does not need the admin mode itself, but the access rights.
Files and folders can have different rights and "owners" in the security layer of a computer.
When copying files between computers, the new computer does not have knowledge on the users of the old computer, so it cannot automatically assign the additional rights - it automatically limits the new access rights to the account the files were copied with.
if you copied them under the admin/default account and only created the user account later, then the user account has no access to those files.
if you don't want to use the admin account for MZ, you'll need to check the access rights on the folders and files of your project and add the user account to them where it is missing.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Amusingly, I just learned about this today - check your file extensions.
MZ on Windows 11 will not load/display in the editor images that have uppercase PNG extensions. Windows should still load them fine in your game if they've already been selected, because the operating system itself isn't case-sensitive.
It could be something else, but it's worth a shot.

Hmm, I just checked all the files have extensions ending with lower cases (.png).
This is weird since it's the first time I'm getting this issue. I was on windows 10 before but I also have a windows 11 laptop and everything worked fine before. Something fishy for sure!
EDIT: I figured it out. RPG Maker MZ needs to run in admin mode, else it won't load the files in the editor.
